description: This file contains unit tests for the AttributeDeleted class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validity.

classes.name: AttributeDeletedTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the AttributeDeleted class functionalities such as immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and constructor validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that AttributeDeleted instances are immutable and that JsonPointer is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of equals and hashCode methods for AttributeDeleted.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeDeleted with a null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeDeleted with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeDeleted with a null attribute key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method of AttributeDeleted produces the expected JsonObject.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that an AttributeDeleted instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.
